html: II. שׁלח (√ of foll.; Arabic سَلَخَ strip off hide, سُلَاخَةٌ piece of hide stripped off; Aramaic שְׁלַח, ܫܠܰܚ take off garment; Arabic سَلْخٌ, Aramaic שִׁלְחָא, ܫܰܠܚܳܐ hide, perhaps also Palm. שלחא (pl.? Lzb; ReckendZMG xlii (1888), 415 cp. i. שֶׁלַח); hence שֻׁלְחָן, q.v. (also NH Ecclus), v. GFMPAOS 1890, lxx; especially Ju 1, 7).
